en: The carvings on the walls look like letters. There are dozens of shapes, and no two quite alike.
When I'm not reading them, I break up the rocks round the Ruins. Fossils turn up inside, now and then. Take this one!
I hear the museum in Pewter City has learned how to bring them back to life. Imagine it!
Back again? I broke open another rock this morning, and look what was inside. You have it.
Two kinds of shell from the old sea, so close to the Ruins. The people who built them must have seen these alive.
